facts.heading: Divorce after fifteen years
facts.content: Jana and her husband Radko decided on a divorce after fifteen years of marriage.
facts.evidence: After fifteen years of marriage, my husband Radko and I decided on a divorce

facts.heading: Divorce conversation in September
facts.content: Radko told Jana in September that their marriage couldn't go on like this.
facts.evidence: in September he told me that it couldn't go on like this

facts.heading: Jana's emotional reaction to news
facts.content: Jana experienced feelings of emptiness and anger several times a day after the news.
facts.evidence: Emptiness, then anger, then emptiness again. It happens several times a day.

facts.heading: Radko's reason for divorce
facts.content: Radko stated that they drifted apart and live next to each other.
facts.evidence: He says that we drifted apart, that we live next to each other.

facts.heading: Jana's self-blame regarding marriage
facts.content: Jana feels she should have noticed the signs of the drifting apart in the marriage.
facts.evidence: That I should have seen it, that I was blind.

facts.heading: Jana's uncertainty about her feelings
facts.content: Jana wonders if she was too tired or if she cared too much for Radko.
facts.evidence: Sometimes I think I was too tired, I didn't care about him.

facts.heading: Struggling due to children
facts.content: Jana is struggling mainly because of her children.
facts.evidence: Yes, mainly because of the children.

facts.heading: Children's names and ages
facts.content: Jana has two children; Anička is 12 and Matěj is 8.
facts.evidence: I have two children, Anička is 12 and Matěj is 8

facts.heading: Delaying telling children about divorce
facts.content: Jana and Radko have not told the children about the divorce yet.
facts.evidence: No. Radek wants us to tell them together, or we postpone it.

facts.heading: Anička suspects fighting
facts.content: Anička asked Jana if Dad and she are fighting last week.
facts.evidence: Last week she asked me if Dad and I are fighting.

facts.heading: Jana lied to Anička
facts.content: Jana lied to Anička about the fighting, which Anička found out.
facts.evidence: Because I lied. And she found out.

facts.heading: Fear of Anička's reaction
facts.content: Jana is afraid of Anička's tears if she tells her the truth.
facts.evidence: but I am afraid of her tears.

facts.heading: Housing arrangements post-divorce
facts.content: The house is on a mortgage, and Radko is likely moving in with his brother.
facts.evidence: The house is on a mortgage, Radek is probably moving in with his brother, at least for now.

facts.heading: Jana's living arrangement
facts.content: The child will stay with Jana.
facts.evidence: The child will stay with me.

facts.heading: Fear of managing alone
facts.content: Jana is afraid she won't manage the situation alone because Radko handled the money.
facts.evidence: I am afraid I won't manage it alone. Radek would always deal with the money.

facts.heading: Jana's employment details
facts.content: Jana works as a Czech teacher in an elementary school in Brno.
facts.evidence: I work as a Czech teacher in an elementary school in Brno.

facts.heading: Feeling life is falling apart
facts.content: Jana feels that everyone sees her life is falling apart in class.
facts.evidence: I have the feeling that everyone sees that my life is falling apart.

facts.heading: Principal knows about situation
facts.content: Only the principal at school knows about Jana's situation.
facts.evidence: Only the principal.

facts.heading: Principal allowed early leave
facts.content: The principal allowed Jana to leave early after Jana cried in the hallway.
facts.evidence: That she let me leave early.

facts.heading: Worse when alone at home
facts.content: Jana felt worse when she sat at home alone compared to being at work.
facts.evidence: But then I sat at home and it was worse.

facts.heading: Wakes at 3 AM thinking
facts.content: Jana wakes up every night at three in the morning thinking about the future.
facts.evidence: Every night I wake up at three in the morning and think about what will happen next.

facts.heading: Worries about finances and children
facts.content: When awake, Jana thinks about not having a mortgage or husband, calculates money, and imagines telling children.
facts.evidence: That I don't have a mortgage, I don't have a husband, I don't have anything.

facts.heading: Sleep pattern after waking
facts.content: Jana falls asleep around five and wakes up at half past seven.
facts.evidence: I fall asleep around five and wake up at half past seven.

facts.heading: Weight loss and eating habits
facts.content: Jana eats little and has lost four kilos.
facts.evidence: I eat little. I've lost four kilos.

facts.heading: Sister Alana in Olomouc
facts.content: Jana has her sister Alana who lives in Olomouc.
facts.evidence: I have my sister Alana in Olomouc.

facts.heading: Friend Eva from work
facts.content: Jana has a friend named Eva from work.
facts.evidence: And my friend Eva from work.

facts.heading: Fear of Eva's judgment
facts.content: Jana fears Eva might think she lied or that a woman who cannot maintain a marriage is not a good example for children.
facts.evidence: That I lied. That a woman who cannot maintain a marriage is not a good example for children.

facts.heading: Mom's influence on marriage view
facts.content: Jana believes her mom influenced her view that marriage is held together by the children.
facts.evidence: Probably from my mom. She always said that marriage is held together by the children.

facts.heading: Mom's recent silence
facts.content: Jana's mom has not spoken much since Jana told her about something.
facts.evidence: She hasn't spoken much since then.

facts.heading: Desire for mom's approval
facts.content: Jana feels she would need her mom to approve of her.
facts.evidence: I would need her to approve of me.

facts.heading: Family's view on loneliness
facts.content: Jana stated that wanting not to be alone is not done in her family.
facts.evidence: That it hurts that I don't want to be alone, but that's not done in our family.

facts.heading: Crying when expressing feelings
facts.content: When Jana says her feelings out loud, she cries and apologizes.
facts.evidence: I cry and apologize.

facts.heading: Help from speaking out loud
facts.content: Jana finds that saying things out loud helps her a little.
facts.evidence: it helps a little.

facts.heading: Sleep and children's future goals
facts.content: Jana's current goals are sleeping better and knowing how to tell her children.
facts.evidence: Sleeping and knowing how to tell the children.

facts.heading: Current sleep aids used
facts.content: Jana uses chamomile tea for sleep and does not want pills from the doctor.
facts.evidence: Chamomile tea and that's it.

facts.heading: Fear of waking for children
facts.content: Jana is afraid she won't be able to wake up in time for the children.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid I won't be able to wake up in time for the children

facts.heading: Avoidance of addiction
facts.content: Jana does not want to be addicted.
facts.evidence: and I don't want to be addicted

facts.heading: Fear of crying in front of children
facts.content: Jana is afraid of crying in front of the children because it would be scary for them.
facts.evidence: That I would cry in front of the children? After all, it would be scary for them

facts.heading: Anička is sensitive
facts.content: Jana believes Anička is sensitive.
facts.evidence: Anička is sensitive

facts.heading: Current test focus
facts.content: Jana's current test is about not feeling alone and not having to manage things right away.
facts.evidence: That I am not alone and that I don't have to manage it right away
